items.label: Perfect for School, Light, and Easy to Carry
items.value: Heading to class or studying at home? The Lenovo IdeaPad 1 is built for students on the go. It’s slim, lightweight, and powered by an Intel Celeron N6000 processor—great for schoolwork, research, emails, and YouTube breaks in between. This laptop is upgraded based on model 82LX00G1US.

items.label: Easy on the Eyes, Great for Online Classes
items.value: The 15.6" Full HD screen with anti-glare reduces eye strain during long study hours. Dolby Audio speakers offer clear sound for lessons and videos, and the 720p webcam with privacy shutter is perfect for online classes and group projects.

items.label: Multitask Like a Pro — School, Notes, and More
items.value: With 20GB of RAM, you can write essays, browse the web, and take notes all at once. The fast 1TB SSD + 128GB eMMC combo gets you into your files quickly—no waiting around before class starts.

items.label: All the Ports You Need with Microsoft 365 & Security Built In
items.value: Connect a mouse, headphones, flash drive, or external screen—this laptop’s got USB-C, USB-A, HDMI, and a card reader built in. It runs on Windows 11, so everything feels modern and familiar from the start. Also includes a 1-Year Microsoft 365 subscription with Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and more—everything a student needs to succeed. Plus, McAfee LiveSafe (30-Day Trial) adds an extra layer of protection for safe online use.

items.label: Battery That Goes From First Period to Homework Time
items.value: No outlet? No problem. With up to 10 hours of battery life, this laptop keeps up with a full school day—plus homework, video calls, or some gaming after.

Compatible Devices
items.value: External displays, mice, keyboards, storage devices, printers, and other accessories designed to interface with USB, HDMI, Thunderbolt, Bluetooth, or Wi-Fi.
